status_summary: The Taxpayer Assistance and Service Act passed the Senate by unanimous consent on 2026-09-30 as a substitute amendment to H.R. 5349, a Tax Court bill the House passed on 2025-12-01, so the House must act again before it can become law. The Senate text had been introduced as S. 3931 on 2026-02-26 and reported by the Finance Committee as S. 5441 on 2026-09-17. As summarized by the Joint Committee on Taxation and a tax publisher, it lets the Tax Court hear refund suits up to 2 million dollars and order refunds in collection due process cases, raises the small tax case limit from 50,000 to 100,000 dollars, makes petition deadlines nonjurisdictional, and requires written supervisory approval before penalties are assessed. No provision equalizing overpayment and underpayment interest rates or extending the time limit for damages suits over improper collection was found, and nothing has been enacted.

timeline.event: The House passes H.R. 5349 (Tax Court Improvement Act), as amended, under suspension of the rules by voice vote.
S. 3931, the Taxpayer Assistance and Service Act, is introduced in the Senate and referred to the Finance Committee.
The Senate Finance Committee votes 26 to 1 to advance the Taxpayer Assistance and Service Act after a markup described in a JCT document dated 2026-07-28.
The Finance Committee reports the bill as an original measure, S. 5441, with Report 119-145; it is placed on the Senate calendar as Calendar No. 670.

The Senate discharges the Finance Committee from H.R. 5349, agrees to a substitute amendment (SA 6847) and a title amendment (SA 6848), and passes the bill with amendments by unanimous consent; the substitute carries the Taxpayer Assistance and Service Act text per a tax publisher.
